newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Safety-Kleen buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Safety-Kleen buy repeated.

text.p: -- Barrington Research said Wednesday it reiterated its buy rating on Safety-Kleen Corp, which on September 30 reported third quarter earnings of $0.24 a share, up from $0.19 a year ago.
-- Barrington said the earnings increase reflects an easy bottom-line comparison since last year's results included unusually high expenses related to the disposal of waste-derived fuels.
-- Barrington said it estimates earnings at $1.05 a share for 1996 and $1.14 for 1997.
